structure: D10-like examination form: a pulse grid (Radial / Femoral / Dorsalis pedis rows x Left / Right columns) of blank value cells; then a one-column table of section cells holding numeric-coded legacy-checkbox columns ('Label<TAB>1 [box]<TAB>2 [box]') under a literal header line ('<TAB>Normal<TAB>Abnormal') on centred tab stops, two unlabelled summary rows (Normal / Abnormal / Not examined) owned by their cell title, and two comment cells whose printed instruction 'Describe any abnormality' sits ABOVE an underscore answer line.
authored_from: build_forms.py intent (f4_exam_grid), written before any engine run on this form
slot_grammar: neutral v3 ground-truth grammar; see check_expected.py

pulse grid header row cells

controls.reason: Column headers. 'Left' and 'Right' name the side of each value cell; they are NOT options (D10: pulse values mapped as choices).

global_rules: No pulse cell is a choice: Left/Right are column sides, not options.
No option label is a response code: '1', '2', '3' never appear as options.
Each coded row is its own question; its options are the literal header words in print order.
extras_policy: Any other answerable field (spacers b/p[1], tr[2]/tc[0]/p[1], tr[3]/tc[0]/p[1], trailing b/p[2], titles, header cells) is a false field.
